lessons.key: surviving_mutant::when a requirement is about what the caller finally receives assert on the serialized response payload not on the intermediate object that produces it otherwise removing the whole step keeps the suite green
lessons.text: When a requirement is about what the caller finally receives, assert on the serialized response payload, not on the intermediate object that produces it — otherwise removing the whole step keeps the suite green.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::for any reported metric assert its computed value and not merely that its key is present in the response
lessons.text: For any reported metric, assert its computed value and not merely that its key is present in the response.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::never assert a call argument with expect any objectcontaining when the argument s exact contents are the security or isolation boundary being tested
lessons.text: Never assert a call argument with expect.any/objectContaining when the argument's exact contents are the security or isolation boundary being tested.

lessons.key: surviving_mutant::a fallback chain a b c needs an explicit test that the lower priority branch is not taken when the higher priority value exists
lessons.text: A fallback chain (a || b || c) needs an explicit test that the lower-priority branch is NOT taken when the higher-priority value exists.

lessons.key: ac_gap::when a requirement says a policy governs every route enumerate the routes and assert the policy on each one a single happy path route leaves early returns unguarded
lessons.text: When a requirement says a policy governs EVERY route, enumerate the routes and assert the policy on each one; a single happy-path route leaves early returns unguarded.

lessons.key: ac_gap::a guard behind an optional config early return is dead until a production caller supplies that config assert the wiring end to end not just the guard in isolation
lessons.text: A guard behind an optional-config early-return is dead until a production caller supplies that config — assert the wiring end-to-end, not just the guard in isolation.

lessons.key: ac_gap::if a degraded compact form is supposed to cost less assert the reduced cost changing only a form label leaves the estimate unchanged and the branch unreachable
lessons.text: If a degraded/compact form is supposed to cost less, assert the reduced cost; changing only a form label leaves the estimate unchanged and the branch unreachable.

lessons.key: ac_gap::an absence assertion not tocontain is only meaningful if the fixture could plausibly have produced the string otherwise it is a tautology
lessons.text: An absence assertion (not.toContain) is only meaningful if the fixture could plausibly have produced the string; otherwise it is a tautology.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::never guard an assertion behind a conditional if x expect if the value can be absent assert which case is expected
lessons.text: Never guard an assertion behind a conditional (if (x) expect(...)) — if the value can be absent, assert which case is expected.

lessons.key: spec_precision_gap::do not verify a source free or size bounded claim against an empty result set the risk only exists when results are present
lessons.text: Do not verify a source-free or size-bounded claim against an empty result set; the risk only exists when results are present.

lessons.key: ac_gap::do not report planned values as executed values if a spec distinguishes skipped from executed with zero results the response must carry what actually ran
lessons.text: Do not report planned values as executed values; if a spec distinguishes skipped from executed-with-zero-results, the response must carry what actually ran.

lessons.text: Before trusting a surviving mutant, confirm the mutated site actually reaches the output; a value later overwritten downstream yields a false survival.
